race.title: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: KEEP ON COBBLING made a winning reappearance last season and can repeat the feat back in calmer waters. Bang-in-form Crafty Gael is feared most on second start for Lizzie Quinlan, with Luminaries perhaps best of the rest. KEEP ON COBBLING CRAFTY GAEL (IRE) LUMINARIES (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Crafty Gael (5/2), The Clonmel Kid (3/1), Luminaries (3/1), Keep On Cobbling (7/2), Muskerry Rock (12/1), Iamcelestialgift (25/1)
